raw_text_content: Ginny Lane Bar & Grill | Waterfront Restaurant in Orange Beach, AL. Come enjoy amazing food, a great atmosphere, & beautiful, waterfront seating at Ginny Lane Bar & Grill in Orange Beach. The best food with the best view at The Wharf! Phone: 251-224-6500 (ext. 1). Email: ginnylanebarandgrill@live.com. Address: 4851 Wharf Parkway Suite 106, Orange Beach, AL 36561. Hours: Monday-Wednesday: 11am-9pm, Thursday-Saturday: 11am-10pm, Sunday: 10am-9pm. Your appetite might lead you here. But our sensational food, waterfront view, and exciting atmosphere will keep you coming back! View Our Menus. Order for Takeout & Delivery. 251-224-6500 (ext. 1). Takeout Family Meals - Family Meals Feed 4. All Meals Served with House or Caesar Salad and Cornbread with Butter. Shrimp & Grits... $38 - Andouille sausage, cheddar grits, creole cream sauce with roasted tomatoes. Choose 2 Sides: Green Beans, White Cheddar Mac & Cheese, Broccoli, Sweet Potato Casserole, Mashed Potatoes, Potato Casserole. Add a Bottle of Wine for $15 (Select Wines Only). Join Our Mailing List.
